microsoft-wordmark.svg.sourceNote: Wikimedia Commons file, described there as the Microsoft logo from 1987 to 2012, extracted from Microsoft's 2007 Local Software Economy Initiative Annual Report. Public-domain text logo on that page. This is not the 2012 four-square mark.
microsoft-wordmark.svg.whyThisFile: The portfolio Microsoft spans run from the late 1990s through March 2015. This wordmark was the company mark for all of that except the last part of the body-tracking bar, which continues after the 2012 change. The later symbol is not used.

amazon-wordmark.svg.sourceNote: Wikimedia Commons file, described there as the corporate logo launched on 25 January 2000 and retired in 2012. Public-domain text logo on that page. This is not the 2012 smile redraw or the 2024 redraw.
amazon-wordmark.svg.whyThisFile: The portfolio Amazon employer row is March 2007 – April 2008, inside the years this wordmark was the company mark. The book-page service and the Kindle e-paper API both use it. A separate Kindle product mark from 2007 was not verified, so it is not drawn.

namesOnly.zenith: Zenith Image Systems sits inside Zenith Electronics in a biography of that unit, but no unit logo was downloaded. A generic Zenith television mark is not used.
namesOnly.new-resolutions: No verified logo. Unrelated modern firms with the same name were not used.
namesOnly.online-resources: The portfolio screen-phone work fits Online Resources Corporation, later bought by ACI. No logo was downloaded, and the ACI mark is not used.
namesOnly.ace: No verified logo. A UK firm with a similar name was not established as the same company.
namesOnly.lcc: The portfolio cellular work matches telecom LCC, not LCC International University. No logo file was downloaded.
namesOnly.ifusion: The 1996–1997 ifusion.com push-media company matches a 1997 report. Modern firms named iFusion were not used, and no logo was downloaded.
namesOnly.spc: Later renamed Systems and Software Consortium. No authenticated logo was found. The bar uses the initials of the portfolio name.
namesOnly.hughes: Richard confirmed Hughes Associates, the fire-engineering firm, for the USAF and Navy firefighter simulators. The Hughes Aircraft mark was removed. Jensen Hughes is the later merged brand and is not used. No original Hughes Associates logo file was found.
namesOnly.forza-kinect-azure-kindle: Forza, Kinect, Azure, and Kindle product marks were not added. Those bars use the Microsoft or Amazon company mark.

magic-leap.svg.sourceNote: Wikimedia Commons file taken from https://www.magicleap.com/. Current company mark. A same-company contemporary mark is used; an older file was not required.
magic-leap.svg.whyThisFile: Same company as the portfolio Magic Leap span. Not a different Magic Leap entity.

quintar.svg.whyThisFile: Contemporary Quintar mark from the company site.

daqri.svg.sourceNote: Third-party file https://cdn.worldvectorlogo.com/logos/daqri.svg, uploaded by Drew Minock in 2018. Not hosted by DAQRI. sha256 a0a026ab6376d687f5a9bb812b9546cf30ca65d3866df1d12d6b0decca9190b9.
daqri.svg.whyThisFile: Recognizable DAQRI wordmark. The old company site no longer serves a logo.

nada.png.whyThisFile: The portfolio names this association. Contemporary official mark.
